title: Evolutionary Design of Interpretable Spatial Descriptors for Structure-Property Relationship Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2611.06811v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Structure property prediction is a classical task in machine learning, ranging from molecular activity and materials properties to local functional responses measured in microscopy. For image-based regression, two choices define the information available to the predictor: the size of the image neighborhood and the spatial resolution retained within it. A small neighborhood can omit relevant surrounding structure, whereas a large, finely sampled neighborhood can introduce redundant or irrelevant information. Here, we develop a framework for constructing spatial descriptors for prediction of local spectra and hysteresis loops. We benchmark regression models, use SHAP maps to examine their spatial attribution, and explore the effect of the patch size and compression to establish the relationship between predictive accuracy and descriptor dimensionality. translated_title: 面向结构-性质关系发现的可解释空间描述子的进化设计
translated_abstract: 结构-性质预测是机器学习中的经典任务，应用范围涵盖从分子活性、材料性质到显微镜下测量的局部功能响应等多个领域。对于基于图像的回归任务，有两个选择决定了预测器可获取的信息：图像邻域的大小以及其中保留的空间分辨率。较小的邻域可能遗漏相关的周围结构，而较大且精细采样的邻域则可能引入冗余或不相关的信息。在此，我们开发了一个用于构建空间描述子的框架，以预测局部光谱和滞回回线。我们对回归模型进行了基准测试，利用SHAP图来考察模型的空间归因，并探索补丁大小与压缩的影响，以建立预测精度与描述子维度之间的关系。随后，我们使用遗传算法来优化空间分区以及测量数据的分配。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合SHAP空间归因分析与遗传算法优化空间分区的框架，用于构建可解释的空间描述子，在预测精度与描述子维度之间取得平衡，以发现结构-性质关系。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a framework that combines SHAP-based spatial attribution analysis with genetic-algorithm optimization of spatial partitions to construct interpretable spatial descriptors that balance predictive accuracy and descriptor dimensionality for structure-property relationship discovery.
